To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Booster performs best when the Linacs are operated with the highest possible beam current.

(1) there is no significant dependence of the Booster charge delivered to the Main Injector on the Linac current, (2) the Booster charge is not dependent on the Linac intensity for Linac currents below the nominal intensity, (3) the Booster charge delivered per turn is not dependent on Linac current, and (4) the Booster charge increases as the number of turns increases.

the Booster efficiency is not a strong function of the Linac intensity, that it is not necessary to operate the Linac at 50% over design intensity in order to get the best Booster performance, and that the best Booster efficiency is found at the lowest Linac intensity.
